ARABIC LANGUAGE — GENERAL ASSESSMENT #18
====

GRADE: Grade 4
SUBJECT: ARABIC LANGUAGE
TIME ALLOWED: 45 minutes
TOTAL MARKS: 30
ASSESSMENT: CBC school-based practice paper

INSTRUCTIONS
----
1. Answer all questions.
2. For calculations, show your working and write the units.
3. For multiple choice, choose the one best answer.
4. Check your work before you hand in.

SECTION A — MULTIPLE CHOICE
----
1. Which Arabic word means "touch your nose"? (1 mark)
   A. اِلْمَسْ أَنْفَكَ
   B. اُخْرُجْ
   C. اِقْرَأْ
   D. أَغْمِضْ عَيْنَيْكَ

2. Which Arabic word means "sky"? (1 mark)
   A. مِصْبَاحٌ
   B. تَحْتَ
   C. ذُرَةٌ
   D. سَمَاءٌ

3. Which Kiswahili word comes from the Arabic word kitaab? (1 mark)
   A. mti
   B. maji
   C. nyumba
   D. kitabu

4. What does the Arabic sentence وَالْمَطَرُ مِنَ السَّمَاءِ mean? (1 mark)
   A. How beautiful the environment is!
   B. And the rain is from the sky.
   C. The sun is in the sky.
   D. I go to school on Monday.

5. What does the Arabic sentence أَنَا تِلْمِيذَةٌ mean? (1 mark)
   A. My name is Ahmad.
   B. I am a pupil (boy).
   C. I am from Kenya.
   D. I am a pupil (girl).

6. What does the Arabic word أَبٌ (ab) mean? (1 mark)
   A. sister
   B. father
   C. mother's brother
   D. father's brother

7. How is the Arabic word أَمَامَ read aloud in English letters? (1 mark)
   A. ʿinda
   B. amaama
   C. fii
   D. taHta

8. What is the sound dh in udhun like in English? (1 mark)
   A. d in 'dog'
   B. th in 'think'
   C. th in 'this'
   D. z in 'zebra'

9. Which Arabic sentence means "We look after the environment." (1 mark)
   A. الْجَوُّ بَارِدٌ
   B. الْجَوُّ حَارٌّ
   C. الْجَوُّ مُمْطِرٌ
   D. نُحَافِظُ عَلَى الْبِيئَةِ

10. Which is the correct order for the sentence 'The pen is in the bag'? (1 mark)
   A. al-qalamu fii l-haqiiba
   B. fii l-haqiiba
   C. fii l-qalamu l-haqiiba
   D. l-haqiiba al-qalamu fii

11. What is a dictation? (1 mark)
   A. You draw a picture
   B. You sing a song
   C. The teacher says a word and you write it
   D. You copy from the board only

12. What does the Arabic sentence الشَّمْسُ حَارَّةٌ mean? (1 mark)
   A. This is the sun.
   B. The wind is strong.
   C. The sun is hot.
   D. This is rain.

13. What does the Arabic sentence لَا تَلْعَبْ بِالسِّكِّينِ mean? (1 mark)
   A. I eat bread.
   B. The key is in the cupboard.
   C. Do not play with the knife.
   D. The chair is at the door.

14. How is the Arabic word مَوْزٌ read aloud in English letters? (1 mark)
   A. sukkar
   B. milh
   C. samak
   D. mawz

15. What does the Arabic sentence فِي بَيْتِي مَطْبَخٌ mean? (1 mark)
   A. This is my room.
   B. Thank you for listening.
   C. In my house there is a kitchen.
   D. I am in Grade 4.

SECTION B — STRUCTURED / SHORT ANSWERS
----
16. Translate into English: ʿiid miilaad saʿiid (2 marks)

17. Describe how to solve a jumbled sentence. (3 marks) (3 marks)

18. Translate into English: ukhtii taqraʾu (2 marks)

19. Write five household items in Arabic (English letters are fine) with their meanings. (5 marks) (5 marks)

20. Give three items from a peer review checklist for reading aloud. (3 marks) (3 marks)
pages.answers:
ARABIC LANGUAGE — GENERAL ASSESSMENT #18 · MARKING SCHEME
====

SECTION A
----
1. A — اِلْمَسْ أَنْفَكَ
   اِلْمَسْ أَنْفَكَ (ilmis anfaka) means touch your nose.

2. D — سَمَاءٌ
   سَمَاءٌ (samaa') means sky.

3. D — kitabu
   The Kiswahili word kitabu (book) came from Arabic kitaab. The other words are Bantu words.

4. B — And the rain is from the sky.
   وَالْمَطَرُ مِنَ السَّمَاءِ (wal-maTaru mina s-samaa'i) means: And the rain is from the sky.

5. D — I am a pupil (girl).
   أَنَا تِلْمِيذَةٌ (anaa tilmiidha) means: I am a pupil (girl).

6. B — father
   أَبٌ (ab) means father.

7. B — amaama
   أَمَامَ is read amaama and means in front of.

8. C — th in 'this'
   The letter dh is like the th in 'this'.

9. D — نُحَافِظُ عَلَى الْبِيئَةِ
   نُحَافِظُ عَلَى الْبِيئَةِ (nuhaafidhu ʿalaa l-bii'a) means: We look after the environment.

10. A — al-qalamu fii l-haqiiba
   The item comes first, then the position word and the place.

11. C — The teacher says a word and you write it
   In a dictation you listen and write what you hear.

12. C — The sun is hot.
   الشَّمْسُ حَارَّةٌ (ash-shamsu haarra) means: The sun is hot.

13. C — Do not play with the knife.
   لَا تَلْعَبْ بِالسِّكِّينِ (laa talʿab bi-s-sikkiin) means: Do not play with the knife.

14. D — mawz
   مَوْزٌ is read mawz and means bananas.

15. C — In my house there is a kitchen.
   فِي بَيْتِي مَطْبَخٌ (fii baytii matbakh) means: In my house there is a kitchen.

SECTION B
----
16. (2 marks)
   Answer: Happy birthday.
   Working / marking points: 1 mark for the subject or first part and 1 mark for the rest of the meaning.

17. (3 marks)
   Answer: Find the word that names the item; find the position or describing word; put them together in the pattern and read aloud to check.
   Working / marking points: 1 mark for each step.

18. (2 marks)
   Answer: My sister reads.
   Working / marking points: 1 mark for the subject or first part and 1 mark for the rest of the meaning.

19. (5 marks)
   Answer: For example bayt (house), ghurfa (room), matbakh (kitchen), hammaam (bathroom), hadiiqa (garden).
   Working / marking points: 1 mark for each correct word with its meaning.

20. (3 marks)
   Answer: Every word read correctly; steady pace; voice rises for questions; pauses at commas; voice shows feeling.
   Working / marking points: 1 mark for each valid item.
